text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 164 tablets of fluconazole 50 mg with 12.8 days on hand. Corvale General holds 289 tablets with 17.6 days on hand. FDA's drug shortage list does not include fluconazole as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include fluconazole as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides limited coverage at both sites. Multiple manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list are available for purchase, though their labeled plants are unidentified. Two additional suppliers have registered plants with recent NAI inspections.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc., Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and AvPAK; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate BluePoint Laboratories and Chartwell RX, LLC as backup sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to verify current compliance status for Golden State Medical Supply, Inc. (FEI 3006458969, last inspection NAI 2025-06-11) and Novitium Pharma LLC (FEI 3012541241, last inspection NAI 2024-02-16); requires Quality Assurance Manager approval.
4. Buyer to report procurement timeline and allocation plan to both sites; requires Operations Manager approval.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
